theorems.name: Submission.p03_odd_prepsi_torsion_68cf3476
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → ∀ (x y : F) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ (W.preΨ' n).eval x = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted EDS existence and identification declarations, translates point-ideal membership into polynomial vanishing, and descends through injective base change.
